label: Pro Tools dock panel open
verdict:
**Not CLEAN — a few real issues, one serious.**

**Layout/overlap/clipping**
1. **[Major – looks broken] Status bar reads `FPS: 2`.** A 2 FPS reading signals the app is crawling or effectively frozen. Even if this is a dev-only readout, on screen it screams "broken."
2. **[Moderate – clipped content]** The floating vertical toolbar's **"VIEW" section shows only the heading — zero visible items** below it. The panel ends right after "Atmosphere" (~y 760), so the VIEW group appears truncated mid-section.
3. **[Minor]** In the left catalog, the **"Patio" item under "Patios & Paths" is sliced in half** by the bottom edge of the sidebar (icon/text cut mid-item). Fine if it's a scroll list, but visually it reads as clipped.
4. **[Minor – data inconsistency]** Status bar says **"Brush: 8 ft"** while the open Pro Terrain Tools panel shows **"Brush Radius 10 ft."** Could be different brushes, but they look contradictory on one screen.

**Confusing/ambiguous**
5. **"Innovate"** in the bottom quick-action row (Tape Measure / Terrain / Excavate / Analyze / **Innovate**) is an odd label in a terrain-tool context — looks like a possible typo for "Irrigate" or a misfiled button.
6. Status bar says **"Tool: Select"** while the BUILD "Pro Tools" tab is active — the active-tool state is ambiguous.
7. Minor redundancy: "Terrain" and "Analyze" appear in both the vertical toolbar and the bottom chip row, and "Sun" button coexists with "Sun & Shadow" — a new user may wonder which set is live.

**5-second comprehension:** Mostly yes — the title, the 3D yard, and a clearly-labeled "Pro Terrain Tools" panel with step-by-step hint text communicate the purpose well. But the triple-stack of controls (left toolbar + center modal + bottom chip row) competes for attention, and the FPS: 2 readout plus the clipped VIEW section undermine trust.

**Summary:** Functional and mostly well-organized, but ship-blockers are the FPS: 2 readout and the truncated VIEW toolbar section; fix those plus the Brush 8 ft/10 ft mismatch and "Innovate" label.
